import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_14/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_14/test_1.csv"
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_14/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load source tables
    df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)

    # Inspect schemas (for clarity, not mandatory)
    # Source0 columns: ['PLAYER', '2017-18']
    # Source1 columns: ['#', 'Player', 'Team', 'GP', 'MPG', 'FGM', 'FGA', 'FG%', '3PM', '3PA', '3P%', 'FTM', 'FTA', 'FT%', 'TOV', 'PF', 'ORB', 'DRB', 'RPG', 'APG', 'SPG', 'BPG', 'PPG']

    # Join Source0 and Source1 on PLAYER == Player
    # This will add the '2017-18' salary column from Source0 to Source1's player stats
    # Use left join on Source1 to keep all player stats, but since Source0 has salary info for these players, inner join is also fine.
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_source1, df_source0, left_on='Player', right_on='PLAYER', how='inner')

    # After merge, columns include:
    # ['#', 'Player', 'Team', 'GP', 'MPG', 'FGM', 'FGA', 'FG%', '3PM', '3PA', '3P%', 'FTM', 'FTA', 'FT%', 'TOV', 'PF', 'ORB', 'DRB', 'RPG', 'APG', 'SPG', 'BPG', 'PPG', 'PLAYER', '2017-18']

    # We want to produce the target schema:
    # ['PLAYER': string, '2017-18': integer, '#': integer, 'Player': string, 'Team': string, 'GP': integer, 'MPG': float, 'FGM': float, 'FGA': float, 'FG%': float, '3PM': float, '3PA': float, '3P%': float, 'FTM': float, 'FTA': float, 'FT%': float, 'TOV': float, 'PF': float, 'ORB': float, 'DRB': float, 'RPG': float, 'APG': float, 'SPG': float, 'BPG': float, 'PPG': float]

    # Select and reorder columns accordingly
    # Note: 'PLAYER' from Source0 and 'Player' from Source1 are both present; keep both as per target schema
    df_target = df_merged[
        ['PLAYER', '2017-18', '#', 'Player', 'Team', 'GP', 'MPG', 'FGM', 'FGA', 'FG%', '3PM', '3PA', '3P%', 'FTM', 'FTA', 'FT%', 'TOV', 'PF', 'ORB', 'DRB', 'RPG', 'APG', 'SPG', 'BPG', 'PPG']
    ].copy()

    # Convert data types to match target schema
    # PLAYER and Player are strings - ensure dtype object/string
    df_target['PLAYER'] = df_target['PLAYER'].astype(str)
    df_target['Player'] = df_target['Player'].astype(str)
    df_target['Team'] = df_target['Team'].astype(str)

    # '2017-18' should be integer (salary)
    df_target['2017-18'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['2017-18'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

    # '#' should be integer
    df_target['#'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['#'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

    # 'GP' should be integer
    df_target['GP'] = pd.to_numeric(df_target['GP'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

    # The rest numeric columns should be float
    float_cols = ['MPG', 'FGM', 'FGA', 'FG%', '3PM', '3PA', '3P%', 'FTM', 'FTA', 'FT%', 'TOV', 'PF', 'ORB', 'DRB', 'RPG', 'APG', 'SPG', 'BPG', 'PPG']
    for col in float_cols:
        df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0.0).astype(float)

    # Write the transformed dataframe to the target CSV file
    df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
